characterBible.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL four-column full-body CHARACTER MODEL SHEET for a hand-drawn children's picture book, ages 7–9. Pure WHITE paper background; no scenery, lettering, labels, logos, swatches, watermark or props. Columns exactly equal width, ample white gaps, all feet visible, common ground baseline. LEFT two columns: same GIRL age8 front and three-quarter. RIGHT two columns: same GRANDFATHER age70 front and three-quarter. Girl is about 72 percent of grandfather's height, sturdy compact build with a broad SQUARE face, medium-brown skin, a few freckles over a broad short nose, SMALL narrow almond-shaped monolid dark eyes spaced widely, straight heavy eyebrows, wide expressive mouth with one slightly uneven front tooth. BLACK tightly curly hair gathered in ONE HIGH PUFF, no bangs, no braid, no bob. TEAL loose boxy short-sleeved T-shirt, BURNT SIENNA wide cropped trousers, cream flat canvas slip-on shoes; no bag or jewellery. Grandfather is tall, lean and gently stooped, a LONG RECTANGULAR face, pronounced cheekbones, long nose, small deep-set eyes and smile wrinkles, BALD CROWN with cropped WHITE hair at sides, thin WHITE moustache, RECTANGULAR wire glasses. Cream short-sleeved shirt, dark forest-green waistcoat with two square pockets, charcoal trousers, brown lace-up shoes. Natural different body proportions: child about five heads tall, adult about seven. LOOSE confident graphite contours, varied pencil pressure, hatching visible, selective FLAT dry colored-pencil clothes. Friendly expressive original faces drawn through brows and mouth; not chibi, no huge round eyes, doll faces, porcelain skin, glossy 3D, anime or photographic realism. Each character has a decisively different silhouette, facial structure and age. Empty relaxed hands. Preserve the same individual features between front and three-quarter.

No recorder, panpipes, sharp splinters, blades, strings, stars or extra objects.
